title: Alignment-Type Share of Cancellation Deductions — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
In the refund of a cancelled Alignment Services & Plans plan, each deducted alignment's value is multiplied by the deduction type share of the alignment performed, as its own work order records the alignment type.

| Alignment type of the deducted alignment | Deduction type share |
|---|---|
| Thrust | 0.80 (80%) |
| Two-wheel | 0.90 (90%) |
| Four-wheel | 1.00 (100%) |

The share applies alignment by alignment: each deducted alignment's own value is multiplied by the share of its own type, whatever value that alignment is deducted at.

**Hypothetical:** a plan with three included alignments, each valued at 100.00 for the illustration — one thrust, one two-wheel and one four-wheel — has deductions of 80.00, 90.00 and 100.00, a total of 270.00.
